text_block_list.text: To reward Zenno Rob Roy for working so hard in her daily training, we came to a book cafe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea a shop like this was near the academy!
How wonderful... There are so many books...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is... a book that was out of print and I couldn't read...
Ah, over there too...!
choice_data_list: Shall we take our time looking around?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Wow... My heart is pounding...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Yes, that's it, that's it!
These have different author names, but they're actually the same person!
It's amazing how they're lined up side-by-side like this!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I read first...!
Hmm-hmm-hmm, hum♪

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Opera O
text_block_list.text: La~ la la~, la~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hawaah!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... A magnificent overture...
Namely, the voices crying out for the arrival of the Supreme Overlord—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And so... here I am, Rob Roy!
Guided by the melody you play!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Um, hello, Opera O-san.
A-Are you here to read books too, Opera O-san...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, to search for a subject for a new opera!
Standing in a forest of books... truly a harmony of intellect and beauty."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, O seeds of this dazzling stage...!
Blossom, so that a brand new me may be born!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, excuse me.
It's just... I thought that was amazing..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So poised... so glamorous...
Like a character straight out of a storybook...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If I want to be a hero, I really have to become like Opera O-san... don't I...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha, why yes, I suppose I am that great!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, hearing that makes sense.
I was wondering why you were humming such an unusual melody—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Rob Roy Overture... I see.
If the hero you aspire to be is Red Rob, then it makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...!?
I-I knew you'd recognize it!!
That song is based on my favorite novel...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That said, I haven't read the original novel yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, um, th-that's far too kind!
It is an older work, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's a wonderful heroic epic with romance and battles, and you can also learn about local culture and history!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A commoner hero standing up against a high-ranking noble is fascinating as a classic archetype, and besides—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah, wah...
I-I'm talking too much... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... Whenever books are involved,
I immediately lose track of my surroundings...
choice_data_list: Let's save the rest for when we can relax over some tea...
You really love that story, huh?
You really love that story, don't you?
Since you have it, why don't you lend them the book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... Whenever books are involved,
I immediately lose track of my surroundings...
choice_data_list: Let's save the rest for when we can relax over some tea...
You really love that story, huh?
You really love that story, don't you?
Since you have it, why don't you lend them the book?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you mind if I join you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? O-Of course!
Having tea with Opera O-san... I'd be honored!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The honor is mine, to share a table with a 'Hero'!
Now then, shall we toast with some sparkling black tea—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, wait... The Supreme Ruler and the Hero...?
Can't I use this theme for my next opera!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: There's no time to waste! I'm sorry, Rob Roy, our tea party will have to wait until next time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh, um...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S... She left... Did I do
something wrong...?
A few days later, however—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—In short, you're the only one who can play the counterpart role!
Lend me your aid, fair book-loving hero!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, me, on Opera O-san's stage!?
I'm flattered, but... there's no way, I'm just not good enough!

With a new script in hand, T.M. Opera O passionately tried to recruit her.
Zenno Rob Roy could only blink in stunned disbelief at the unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, that's right! There are many heroic tales out there, but this one's special to me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's where it all began... That's why I really want to cherish it...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Sorry to interrupt suddenly.
I overheard you talking and got curious...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you tell me
a bit more about the book you were just discussing...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ah, I want to hear it too! I've never read heroic tales before, but I've always been interested!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course...!
Um... but are you really sure...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well.
As expected of a cafe where book lovers gather, it's very popular.

Zenno Rob Roy answers the questions with flushed cheeks.
Her lively exchange with a fellow enthusiast continued well afterward.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, I can lend it to you right away once we get back to the dorm.
I-It's really interesting, so if you'd like...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! I would love to.
A good story is essential for a good opera, after all!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then in return, I invite you to my room!
I'm sure you'll love my treasured collection
that helped build my opera...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Th-Thank you so much!
I'm in your care!

Zenno Rob Roy laughs happily.
I watched warmly over the two of them,
their bond clearly deepened.
